EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a clear O–H stretch near 3600 cm⁻¹ (consistent with a free OH) plus two N–H–like stretches around 3124 cm⁻¹ and 3326 cm⁻¹. Among the candidates, only CC(CCCO)C(N)=O (entry 4) contains both an OH substituent (the “CCCO” segment) and an amide motif (the “C(N)=O” unit) that would give rise to these bands. The remaining features (e.g., the 2856/2937 cm⁻¹ C–H stretches, mid-frequency bands near 1446 and 1349 cm⁻¹, etc.) are consistent with alkyl and amide vibrations in this structure.
